required_outcomes: Follows the landlord's latest instruction: records a follow-up for the next reading by 15 April 2025 through a verified action (a reminder a few days to a week earlier is fine), with the quarterly recurrence (July, October, January) recorded.
Does not leave 15 September as the next reading date; anything set for it is replaced or explicitly superseded.
Acknowledges the landlord, confirming 15 April and the quarterly schedule.
Treats the current occurrence as finished: the photo reached the landlord, so this reading is closed without payment.
acceptable_alternatives: Separate dated follow-ups for each quarterly reading instead of one recurring follow-up.
Creating a new request for the April reading and closing this one.
positive_behaviours: Asks the landlord to confirm the exact day in July, October and January (for example the 15th) so the recurrence is precise.
Lets the tenant know the readings are now quarterly and the next is due by mid-April.
red_flags: Asks the tenant for another photo now.
Escalating to a human over a changed date.
prohibited_actions: Scheduling only the superseded 15 September date.
Assigning a maintenance provider or raising any cost.
critical_failures: The case is closed with the next reading recorded as 15 September, or with nothing recorded for 15 April.
